name: India Today
tagline: India's Leading News & Current Affairs Weekly
description: India Today is an Indian English and Hindi language weekly news magazine published by Living Media India Limited. It is the most widely circulated news magazine in India with deep credibility and high-income demographic readership.
readershipProfile: Decision makers, corporate executives, politicians, entrepreneurs and urban households seeking in-depth investigative reports, political analysis and market trends.
minimumBooking: 1 Insertion (Booking deadline 7 days prior to issue release)

name: Forbes India
tagline: The Voice of Entrepreneurship & Wealth Leadership
description: Forbes India is the Indian edition of Forbes, operated by Network18 Media. It delivers authoritative insights on wealth creators, venture capital, technology disruptions, and corporate power lists.
readershipProfile: C-suite executives, high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), angel investors, founders, and senior financial strategists.

name: Vogue India
tagline: The Ultimate Authority in Luxury, Fashion & Culture
description: Vogue India is the definitive fashion and luxury lifestyle publication published by Condé Nast India. Renowned for curated editorial shoots, haute couture runways, and celebrity profiles.
readershipProfile: Affluent fashion-conscious consumers, luxury shoppers, beauty trendsetters, and metropolitan trend drivers.

name: Business Today
tagline: India's Most Read Business Magazine
description: Business Today provides extensive analysis of corporate developments, market strategies, startup ecosystems, and fiscal policies influencing the Indian economy.
readershipProfile: Managers, corporate board directors, investment bankers, enterprise buyers, and financial consultants.

name: Femina
tagline: Inspiring Indian Women Since 1959
description: Femina is India's first and most celebrated women's lifestyle brand published by Worldwide Media (Times Group). It touches upon wellness, fashion, relationships, career, and culture.
readershipProfile: Progressive, modern women, aspiring female entrepreneurs, homemakers, and urban young adults.

name: Elle India
tagline: Style, Substance and Unapologetic Living
description: Elle India is an international fashion, beauty and lifestyle powerhouse, celebrating contemporary style, emerging creative voices, and global luxury aesthetics.
readershipProfile: Discerning young professionals, stylists, luxury shoppers, and creative tastemakers across metros.

name: Outlook India
tagline: Bold Investigative Journalism & Political Perspective
description: Outlook is one of India's premier independent news magazines known for fearless reportage, political depth, and social commentary.
readershipProfile: Civil servants, legal luminaries, academics, policy analysts, and politically aware citizens.

name: The Week
tagline: Journalism with a Human Heart
description: The Week, published by Malayala Manorama Group, delivers balanced news analysis, health insights, lifestyle essays, and cultural commentary across urban India.
readershipProfile: Educated family households, senior executives, defense personnel, and civil service aspirants.

name: Reader's Digest India
tagline: Inspiration, Knowledge and Everyday Wisdom
description: Reader's Digest is one of the most loved pocket-sized family magazines in India, featuring heartwarming true stories, health breakthroughs, vocabulary enrichment, and humor.
readershipProfile: Multi-generational family homes, retirees, school students, and professionals valuing trusted longevity.

name: GQ India
tagline: Gentlemen's Guide to Fashion, Tech and Success
description: GQ India curates masculine fashion, luxury watches, grooming, fitness, automobile excellence, and modern leadership for the stylish Indian male.
readershipProfile: Urban men aged 24-45, corporate executives, tech founders, and luxury watch and auto enthusiasts.

name: Filmfare
tagline: The Crown Jewel of Indian Cinema & Pop Culture
description: Filmfare is India's most iconic Bollywood and entertainment magazine. It hosts the prestigious Filmfare Awards and features exclusive celebrity interviews and movie spotlights.
readershipProfile: Cinema enthusiasts, youth, young couples, and entertainment followers across Tier 1 & Tier 2 cities.

name: Digit
tagline: Your Technology Navigator
description: Digit is India's top consumer technology and computing publication, providing detailed hardware benchmarks, gadget reviews, AI insights, and DIY guides.
readershipProfile: Software engineers, tech early adopters, gamers, engineering students, and IT procurement specialists.

name: PCQuest
tagline: Enterprise Tech & Cloud Architecture Strategies
description: PCQuest by CyberMedia is dedicated to CIOs, CTOs, IT managers, and enterprise tech architects navigating cloud transitions, cybersecurity, and data center investments.
readershipProfile: Chief Information Officers, IT heads, systems architects, and enterprise software buyers.

name: Indian Journal of Medical Research
tagline: Peer-Reviewed Medical Science & Clinical Studies
description: The Indian Journal of Medical Research (IJMR) is published by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). It is one of the oldest and most cited medical journals in South Asia.
readershipProfile: Senior doctors, surgeons, medical researchers, pharmaceutical developers, and hospital directors.

name: Express Healthcare
tagline: Hospital Administration & MedTech Innovations
description: Express Healthcare by Indian Express Group focuses on hospital management, healthcare technology, diagnostic equipment, and medical infrastructure procurement.
readershipProfile: Hospital administrators, medical superintendents, diagnostic lab chains, and medtech device buyers.

name: Outlook Traveller
tagline: India's Definitive Experiential Travel Companion
description: Outlook Traveller covers uncharted destinations, heritage getaways, culinary explorations, and luxury stays across India and the globe.
readershipProfile: Avid vacationers, luxury resort bookers, high-spending road trippers, and tourism boards.

name: Autocar India
tagline: First with the News, Best with the Tests
description: Autocar India is the nation's leading automotive publication, delivering thorough car and bike road tests, motorsport insights, and EV reviews.
readershipProfile: Auto enthusiasts, vehicle buyers, motorsport followers, and high-income gadget and auto accessorizers.

name: Sportstar
tagline: The Pulse of Indian and World Athletics
description: Sportstar, from the publishers of The Hindu, has chronicled Indian cricket, Olympics, football, badminton, and grassroots athletics for four decades.
readershipProfile: Youth athletes, sports superfans, tournament followers, and fitness enthusiasts.

name: Competition Success Review (CSR)
tagline: Empowering Ambitions for Civil Services & Competitive Exams
description: CSR is India's most read career and competitive exam preparation magazine, trusted by millions of UPSC, banking, MBA, and government service aspirants.
readershipProfile: College students, civil service candidates, competitive exam aspirants, and academic coaching faculties.

name: Education World
tagline: The Human Development Magazine
description: Education World focuses on school rankings, pedagogy innovations, higher education reforms, and educational institution leadership.
readershipProfile: School principals, trustees, university deans, edtech founders, and parents seeking schooling options.

name: Grihshobha
tagline: India's Highest Read Women's Magazine in Hindi
description: Grihshobha, published by Delhi Press, is the undisputed leader in Hindi women's journalism, featuring homemaking, relationship guidance, recipes, and fiction.
readershipProfile: Homemakers, regional women entrepreneurs, joint families across Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, and Delhi NCR.

name: Vanitha
tagline: The Voice of Kerala's Modern Households
description: Vanitha by Malayala Manorama is the highest-circulated women's magazine in India, read in virtually every literate home and NRI diaspora family across the Gulf.
readershipProfile: Kerala women, high-income Malayali families, Gulf NRIs, and consumer household decision makers.

name: Ananda Vikatan
tagline: Tamil Nadu's Iconic Cultural Chronicle
description: Ananda Vikatan is the premier Tamil weekly magazine founded in 1926, covering literature, cinema, politics, and social movements with wit and authority.
readershipProfile: Tamil families, students, cinema fans, and politically engaged citizens across Tamil Nadu and global Tamil diaspora.

name: Swati Sapari Vara Patrika
tagline: The Beloved Household Companion of Andhra & Telangana
description: Swati Sapari Vara Patrika is the largest circulated Telugu weekly magazine, famous for serialized novels, cinema coverage, home management, and short stories.
readershipProfile: Telugu-speaking households across Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, and rural Telangana & Andhra Pradesh.

name: Sananda
tagline: The Intelligent Woman's Voice in Bengal
description: Sananda, published by ABP Group (Anandabazar Patrika), is Eastern India's most influential women's lifestyle and cultural periodical.
readershipProfile: Modern Bengali women, working professionals, cultural organizers, and culinary and fashion enthusiasts in Kolkata and West Bengal.

name: Lokprabha
tagline: Deep-Dive Marathi Current Affairs & Thought Leadership
description: Lokprabha is a respected Marathi weekly magazine by Indian Express Group, providing rigorous political debate, economic analysis, and rural Maharashtra grassroots coverage.
readershipProfile: Maharashtra policymakers, agricultural business owners, educators, and regional opinion builders.

name: Chitralekha
tagline: The Spirit of Gujarati Enterprise & Culture
description: Chitralekha has been Gujarat's most celebrated weekly magazine for over seven decades, combining business acumen, community affairs, global Gujarati diaspora news, and cultural entertainment.
readershipProfile: Gujarati business communities, traders, families, stock market investors, and NRI Gujarati diaspora.

name: Taranga
tagline: Karnataka's Premier Kannada Family Weekly
description: Taranga, published by Manipal Media Network (Udayavani), is Karnataka's foremost Kannada weekly featuring inspiring stories, literature, Sandalwood cinema, and family enrichment.
readershipProfile: Kannada-speaking households, teachers, local businesses, and cultural associations across Karnataka.

name: Jag Bani Magazine
tagline: The Premier Punjabi Community & Heritage Weekly
description: Jag Bani Magazine by Punjab Kesari Group is the leading Punjabi publication covering Punjab politics, agricultural developments, immigration trends, and diaspora life.
readershipProfile: Punjabi families, farmers, NRI sponsors, regional industrialists, and youth exploring global study opportunities.

name: Overdrive
tagline: Passion for Motoring
description: Overdrive by Network18 is one of India's most authoritative magazines for automobile reviews, cross-country road trips, track tests, and automotive tech.
readershipProfile: Car and superbike buyers, weekend road trippers, auto accessory seekers, and high-income young males.

name: Harper's Bazaar India
tagline: Where Fashion Becomes Art
description: Harper's Bazaar India features high-end couture, fine jewelry, art collections, and editorial storytelling by the world's most visionary photographers and writers.
readershipProfile: HNIs, luxury bridal shoppers, jewelry collectors, and connoisseurs of art and international design.

name: Travel + Leisure India & South Asia
tagline: Inspiring the World's Most Discerning Travelers
description: Travel + Leisure India & South Asia is the global standard in luxury vacations, boutique retreats, culinary tours, and luxury aviation.
readershipProfile: Affluent globe-trotters, luxury resort seekers, private aviation users, and international business travelers.

name: Stardust
tagline: The Pioneer of Unfiltered Bollywood Glitz
description: Stardust has reigned as a trailblazing entertainment magazine for five decades, delivering candid star confessions, film previews, and red carpet coverage.
readershipProfile: Movie lovers, salon visitors, college students, and pop-culture enthusiasts.

name: Asian Hospital & Healthcare Management
tagline: Healthcare Infrastructure & Clinical Leadership
description: Asian Hospital & Healthcare Management is a quarterly B2B publication offering executive analysis on hospital engineering, healthcare IT, robotics, and facility design.
readershipProfile: Hospital CXOs, healthcare investors, biomedical department heads, and government health secretaries.

name: Financial Express India Best Banks Annual
tagline: The Definitive Banking & Fintech Yearbook
description: Financial Express India's Best Banks is an annual prestige compendium reviewing capital adequacy, fintech developments, and banking leadership across India.
readershipProfile: Bank MDs, NBFC founders, treasury managers, institutional investors, and fintech unicorns.

name: Architecture+Design (A+D)
tagline: India's Premier Journal of Architecture & Spatial Innovation
description: Architecture+Design documents landmark architectural projects, interior design breakthroughs, sustainable facades, and urban planning across the subcontinent.
readershipProfile: Architects, interior designers, urban planners, real estate developers, and high-end construction material specifiers.

name: The Hindu Sunday Magazine
tagline: Reflective Weekend Reading on Culture, Books & Society
description: The Hindu Sunday Magazine is a weekly supplement bundled with the daily paper, renowned for literary essays, art reviews, science commentary, and environmental features.
readershipProfile: Intellectual households, academics, civil service candidates, and discerning urban families.

name: Cosmopolitan India
tagline: The World’s Largest Selling Young Women’s Magazine
description: Cosmopolitan India is the definitive style and relationship monthly for spirited, ambitious young Indian women. Published under license by India Today Group.
readershipProfile: Fashion-forward young women, urban female executives, beauty enthusiasts, and college graduates.

name: Fortune India
tagline: The Global Business Magazine for Strategic Decision Makers
description: Fortune India is the leading monthly for business leaders, known for authoritative rankings like Fortune 500 India and deep corporate investigations.
readershipProfile: CEOs, CXOs, venture capitalists, senior management and corporate directors.
